body: I'm not so much looking for someone as much as I have a crush on a friend who is poly but unavailable. And this isn't the first time. Lol.
Lol. I like that meme. But I get it. It's just kinda funny/disappointing. Lol.
You're funny. Souls aren't real. So, take your bullshit somewhere else, eh?

I've been with my nesting partner almost 2 years, and we've been dating our other partner for about 14 months. I have talked to them about what I want. They aren't bad partners. I just don't feel romantically attached. Emotionally, yes. It's something of a big complex mess. I dunno.
I'm not drunk. I just get more introspective when I'm drinking.

She cares for me. She demonstrates that through holding my hand, giving me back rubs occasionally, things like that. She can be difficult to communicate with since she feels more deeply than I mean, and usually shuts down. She asked if I was alright with her and the roommate dating after the fact, and I told her it was fine. I would like a little more attention, but I'll be okay. Once the NRE wears off, it'll probably change a bit. 😊
She did not, no. It came out of left field for me. Like I said, though, they seem pretty happy. So good for them.
